name: Kota-Green by TAKASU TILE
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
This recipe, which was designed to create gentle tones in your images, is inspired by the countryside and based on the place I live, Kota town, where the people are warm and green abounds. The low contrast of this recipe makes it good for colorful photos of vegetables and so on. As the name "Kota-Green" suggests, I hope you’ll enjoy it for greenery and flowers, especially green subjects and scenes. I think increasing exposure slightly with shooting will achieve even better results.
